title: Deeper/broader peer release maturity and loss-evidence refresh
mode: primary-source web research and plan refinement
scope: Refresh release-versus-development evidence for independent DWG/DXF implementations
Cross-check current peer loss, parser-safety, and writer-acceptance reports against existing local plan owners
Reconcile the maturity of ACIS/SAB DXF inspectors and raw geometry projection routes
Refine peer admission and implementation-ready evidence without creating duplicate local findings

method.kind: Read current official release, source, issue, pull-request, and documentation pages; reconcile with current local plan sections
method.limitations: Issue content is reporter evidence and was not reproduced. Release matrices and mutable source pages are not runtime qualification. No local defect or format rule was inferred from peer implementations; the repository-pinned ODA v5.4.1 specification remains authoritative for DWG layout. A separate local S8.3 implementation slice and its build/test are documented in datastorage-aggregate-payload-retention-cap-fast-slice-2026-10-18.json.

sources.project: ACadSharp release and live issue version split
sources.revision: Release page listed v3.7.1 dated 2026-08-18; issue bodies contain reports against 3.4.9, 3.6.35, 3.8.0, and 3.8.14/master; reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: The live reports describe distinct, version-specific failure shapes: missing AC1014 VERTEX subtype marker, culture-sensitive codepage selection, recursive repeated-input stack growth, missing AC1032 INSERT-derived records, an unresolved AC1032 whole-file AutoCAD MTEXT rejection, and a SPLINE conversion report without a field-level expected curve. The project's version/operation matrix does not establish those outcomes or the exact behavior of a different release.

sources.revision: Open PR/issue pages reviewed 2026-10-18; #1150 discussion updated 2026-10-01
sources.observed: The ACIS writer work remains an open, refactor-sensitive branch rather than a release baseline. The #1150 discussion reports a post-schema-refactor loss where only the last ACDSDATA group-310 line was retained by the reader, and maintainer discussion says a schema-based writer direction is preferred. This reinforces separate tests for multi-chunk retention, writer output, independent reopen, and native application acceptance.

sources.revision: 0.14.1 NEWS dated 2026-07-25; manual and release history reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: NEWS records current security and hardening fixes, including section decompression and page-map bounds. The manual says R2007 write support is absent and R2010-R2018 output may fail CRC and CAD audit checks. These are peer-specific claims and do not establish a matching local defect or support grade.

sources.project: ezdxf and GDAL ACIS/DXF observation limits
sources.observed: ezdxf documents a raw SAT/SAB browser/export path but no ACIS rendering or general 3D engine; GDAL's extended DXF path exposes raw ASM/transform data rather than a B-rep solid. These routes can observe specific carrier data but cannot qualify DWG AcDs linkage or general solid semantics.

assessment.planImpact: Refreshes existing PAR-07/S8 peer-admission and stage-specific loss-detection guidance. Existing parser-safety, Turkish codepage, classic VERTEX, INSERT ownership, MTEXT, SPLINE, ACIS carrier, and native-consumer owners cover the surfaced risk shapes; no duplicate finding or test is warranted. Peer comparisons must pin released artifact versus mutable head, version, operation, direction, and diagnostics. The next local accounting boundary is linked entity/modeler copies after parser retention.

implementationReadyChecks: Pin each peer run to an immutable release or commit and record artifact hash, license, build options, platform, file version, operation, direction, command, and diagnostics.
Classify each object by source handle, type, physical owner/block path, and carrier as typed, raw-preserved, skipped-with-diagnostic, or fatal; compare payload byte length/hash where applicable.
Do not infer file-format rules or local failures from issue reports, undocumented crash thresholds, aggregate entity counts, or project-wide capability percentages.
Reuse the existing focused local owner and CTest when touching a matching path; do not install peers, add fixtures, or expand routine validation solely because of this research.
Run native/peer acceptance only at the existing composed checkpoint; if a route or required artifact is unavailable, mark that evidence cell NOT_RUN/NOT_QUALIFIED and continue local work.
Keep parser payload retention, linked entity copies, raw carrier preservation, semantic interpretation, and native consumer acceptance as distinct memory/evidence stages.
